about_the_game:
This DLC is a Supporter Pack for "Coin Push Hero," featuring signboard girl skin content. It does not contain any numerical values or other elements that affect the gameplay experience.

DLC Content: Includes 8 interactive actions with the signboard girl (e.g., head pat, happy), and over 15 lines of Japanese and Chinese voice-over.

Brand New Signboard Girl! Kaguya Shinguuji!!
Name: Kaguya Shinguuji
Gender: Female
Height: 165cm
Age: 18 (First year at a top private university / Newly elected Student Council President)

Background:
The sole heir to the mighty Shinguuji conglomerate, she received an elite education from childhood and grew up in an unimaginably privileged environment that most can only dream of. Her every move exudes the elegance and refinement expected of a noble young lady, making her widely recognized in social circles as the "Perfect Ojou-sama." Her academic performance consistently ranks at the top. With impeccable ability and an authoritative yet approachable demeanor, she served as student council president in high school and was swiftly re-elected upon entering a top-tier university. She excels at strategy, coordination, and public speaking, earning the trust of her teachers and the admiration of her peers.
However, this perfect lady harbors a huge secret unknown to others—she is utterly addicted to arcade coin pushers! It all started with a single act of accidental "rebellion" in her youth when she sneaked into an arcade. She was completely captivated by the dazzling lights, the cacophony of clinking coins, and the instant thrill of the coin pusher. Since then, beyond high-end salons and private concerts, seedy or trendy game centers have become her "sanctuary" for releasing stress and seeking pure joy.

Personality:
In Public: The image of a flawless student council president. Confident, calm, rational, commanding yet with just the right amount of elegance and aloofness. Her speech and conduct are impeccable; she handles affairs swiftly and decisively, demonstrating strong leadership and a sense of responsibility. She holds herself to extremely high standards, exhibiting slight perfectionist and tsundere tendencies.
In Private (Arcade Mode): It's like a seal is lifted when she enters the arcade! Her gaze becomes sharp and focused, her嘴角 (lips) curl into an unconscious smile, and she occasionally even shows childlike excitement and tension ("Ah! So close! One more coin!"). In front of the coin pusher, she is no longer the lofty Ojou-sama but an immersed and passionate player. She will clench her fist and whisper cheers for a perfect push, or stomp her foot in frustration when she misses by a hair's breadth (though she quickly regains her composure to analyze the situation).
